source.note: Generated from Genshin Optimizer sheets (master) + allStat_gen skillParam. Hit keys match GO target paths; multKey = <hitKey>_mult. Levels: Lv10, except constellation-boosted talents of 4-star characters at Lv13 (C6 assumed). Normal/charged/plunging default to physical unless the sheet overrides the element (infusions are NOT applied). Unparsed GO formulas (add manually if needed): ['skill.quillDmg: skipped (helper/cond formula)'].

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Elemental Skill (Spring Spirit Summoning), self half: the Icy Quill raises the DMG of Normal, Charged and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts that deal CRYO DMG by 82.18% of Shenhe's current ATK (skill Lv10). She is one of the nearby party members it is granted to, so when SHE is the scored character it reads her own live ATK through cryo_dmgIncFromAtk_ - element-scoped, not attack-type-scoped, because the clause keys off the DMG being Cryo whatever deals it. C3 raises Spring Spirit Summoning by three levels to Lv13 and the share with it (97.02%), hence the constellationStates block. The teammate half is skillIcyQuillFromAtk in others scope, which reads her ATK off a statInput instead. NOTE the Quill is consumed per trigger - 5 charges on Press, 7 on Hold - so weight the rotation accordingly rather than assuming every Cryo hit gets it.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Elemental Burst (Divine Maiden's Deliverance): the Talisman Spirit's field lowers the Cryo RES and Physical RES of opponents inside it by 15% (burst Lv10). The value caps at 15% from Lv10 upward, so C5's +3 burst levels do not raise it and no constellationStates tier is needed. Team scope and a fixed value, so it needs no self/others split. The field lasts 12s, 18s at C2.

C2 Centered Spirit: characters inside Divine Maiden's Deliverance's field have their Cryo CRIT DMG increased by 15% (the constellation's other half extends the field by 6s, which is uptime rather than a stat). Element-scoped, so it reaches every Cryo hit and nothing else.
A1 Deific Embrace: an active character standing within the field created by Divine Maiden's Deliverance (Elemental Burst) gains a 15% Cryo DMG Bonus.

A4 Spirit Communion Seal: Press grants the team +15% Elemental Skill and Burst DMG, Hold grants +15% Normal/Charged/Plunging DMG. They are alternatives at C0 because Shenhe has one skill charge — but C1 Clarity of Heart adds a second Press charge, so a C1+ rotation can land both seals and carry all five bonuses at once. Pick 'tapAndHold' for that.

others_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Elemental Skill (Spring Spirit Summoning): the Icy Quill raises the DMG nearby party members deal with Normal, Charged and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts that deal CRYO DMG by 82.18% of Shenhe's current ATK (skill Lv10), rising to 97.02% at C3, which takes the talent to Lv13 - that is the constellationRates block. An Additive Base DMG Bonus, so it lands on cryo_dmgInc. Type Shenhe's ATK into the input; leaving it blank assumes 2,400. Others scope, so this is offered only when she is a teammate; when she is the scored character the self-scope half reads her live ATK instead. NOTE the Quill is consumed per trigger - 5 charges on Press, 7 on Hold - so weight the rotation accordingly rather than assuming every Cryo hit gets it.

auto.name: Dawnstar Piercer
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skill.name: Spring Spirit Summoning
skill.desc: The frosted dew, silvery and dense, shall exorcise all demons. Grants all nearby party members the Icy Quill effect and deals Cryo DMG in different ways based on whether it is pressed or held. Press Rushes forward together with a Talisman Spirit, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents along the path. Hold Commands the Talisman Spirit to deal AoE Cryo DMG. Icy Quill When Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts deal Cryo DMG to opponents, the DMG dealt is increased based on Shenhe's current ATK. The Icy Quill's effects will be cleared once its duration ends or after being triggered a certain number of times. When held rather than pressed, the Icy Quill's effect lasts longer and can be triggered more times. When one Cryo DMG instance strikes multiple opponents, the effect is triggered multiple times based on the number of opponents hit. The number of times the effect is triggered is calculated independently for each party member with the Icy Quill. The power of the spirits is no falsehood. Burdened with her orders, the divine maiden hurries on!

burst.name: Divine Maiden's Deliverance
burst.desc: Unleashes the power of the Talisman Spirit, allowing it to roam free in this plane, dealing AoE Cryo DMG. The Talisman Spirit then creates a field that decreases the Cryo RES and Physical RES of opponents within it. It also deals periodic Cryo DMG to opponents within the field. The way of the adepti is not defined only by the mysterious and fantastical. Only by observing the changes in the heavens and the earth, and understanding the laws of cause and effect in this realm, may its essence be understood.

passives.name: Deific Embrace
passives.desc: An active character within the field created by <k>Divine Maiden's Deliverance</k> gains 15% <e:cryo>Cryo DMG Bonus</e>.

passives.name: Spirit Communion Seal
passives.desc:
After Shenhe uses <k>Spring Spirit Summoning</k>, she will grant all nearby party members the following effects:
· Press: Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG increased by 15% for 10s.
· Hold: Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG increased by 15% for 15s.

passives.name: Precise Comings and Goings
passives.desc: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Liyue Expedition for 20 hours.

constellations.name: Clarity of Heart
constellations.desc: <k>Spring Spirit Summoning</k> can be used 1 more time.

constellations.name: Centered Spirit
constellations.desc: <k>Divine Maiden's Deliverance</k> lasts for 6 seconds longer. Active characters within the skill's field deal 15% increased <e:cryo>Cryo</e> CRIT DMG.

constellations.name: Seclusion
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Spring Spirit Summoning</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Insight
constellations.desc:
When characters under the effect of <k>Icy Quill</k> applied by Shenhe trigger its DMG Bonus effects, Shenhe will gain a Skyfrost Mantra stack:
· When Shenhe uses <k>Spring Spirit Summoning</k>, she will consume all stacks of Skyfrost Mantra, increasing the DMG of that Spring Spirit Summoning by 5% for each stack consumed.
· Max 50 stacks. Stacks last for 60s.

constellations.name: Divine Attainment
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Divine Maiden's Deliverance</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Mystical Abandon
constellations.desc: When characters trigger <k>Icy Quill</k>'s effects using Normal and Charged Attack DMG, it does not count toward the Trigger Quota.

auto.name: Percée des étoiles
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Enchaîne jusqu'à 5 coups de lance.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Consomme de l'endurance pour charger en ligne droite et infliger des DGT aux ennemis en chemin.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Plonge depuis les airs pour frapper le sol, infligeant des DGT aux ennemis en chemin et des DGT de zone à l'impact.

skill.name: Invocation d'esprit printanier
skill.desc: La rosée givrée et argentée exorcisera tous les démons. Accorde l'effet Pennage glacé à tous les membres de l'équipe à proximité, et inflige des DGT Cryo de différentes manières selon la méthode de déclenchement : Appui simple Se précipite vers l'avant avec un esprit talismanique, infligeant des DGT Cryo aux ennemis en chemin. Appui long Ordonne à l'esprit talismanique d'infliger des DGT Cryo de zone. Pennage glacé Lorsqu'une attaque normale, chargée ou plongeante, une compétence ou un déchaînement élémentaires inflige des DGT Cryo à un ennemi, les DGT infligés augmentent en fonction de l'ATQ actuelle de Shenhe. Les effets du pennage glacé disparaissent à la fin de sa durée ou après avoir activé un certain nombre de cumuls. En utilisant un pennage glacé avec un appui long à la place d'un appui simple, sa durée et le nombre de cumuls générés augmentent. Lorsqu'une attaque de DGT Cryo touche plusieurs ennemis en même temps, les cumuls sont consommés selon le nombre d'ennemis touchés. Les cumuls de pennage glacé sont calculés indépendamment pour tous les personnages de l'équipe. « Le pouvoir des esprits n'est pas un mensonge. Même accablée par les ordres, la demoiselle divine continue ! »

burst.name: Délivrance de la demoiselle divine
burst.desc: Libère la puissance de l'esprit talismanique, lui permettant de se déplacer librement dans ce plan d'existence pour infliger des DGT Cryo de zone. L'esprit talismanique crée alors un champ qui diminue les RÉS Cryo et physique des ennemis, et inflige des DGT Cryo de façon continue aux ennemis à l'intérieur. « La voie des Adeptes n'est pas pour ceux pris dans le mystère et l'imagination. Ce n'est qu'en observant les changements des cieux et de la terre, et en comprenant les lois de cause à effet de ce royaume, que l'on peut saisir son essence. »

passives.name: Étreinte divine
passives.desc: Lorsque le personnage déployé est dans le champ généré par <k>Délivrance de la demoiselle divine</k>, son <e:cryo>bonus de DGT Cryo</e> augmente de 15 %.

passives.name: Sceau de communion spirituelle
passives.desc:
Lorsque Shenhe utilise <k>Invocation d'esprit printanier</k>, tous les personnages de l'équipe à proximité bénéficient des effets suivants :
· Appui simple : les DGT infligés par les compétences et les déchaînements élémentaires augmentent de 15 % pendant 10 s.
· Appui long : les DGT infligés par les attaques normales, chargées et plongeantes augmentent de 15 % pendant 15 s.

passives.name: Arrivée opportune
passives.desc: Augmente les récompenses d'une expédition de 20 h à Liyue de 25 %.

constellations.name: Clarté du cœur
constellations.desc: Confère une utilisation supplémentaire d'<k>Invocation d'esprit printanier</k>.

constellations.name: Esprit centré
constellations.desc: Prolonge la durée de <k>Délivrance de la demoiselle divine</k> de 6 s. De plus, les DGT CRIT des <e:cryo>DGT Cryo</e> du personnage déployé dans le champ augmentent de 15 %.

constellations.name: Isolement
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Invocation d'esprit printanier</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Clairvoyance
constellations.desc:
Lorsqu'un personnage affecté par le <k>pennage glacé</k> de Shenhe déclenche l'effet de bonus de DGT de la flèche, Shenhe obtient 1 cumul de mantra de givre :
· Lorsque Shenhe utilise <k>Invocation d'esprit printanier</k>, tous les cumuls de mantra de givre sont consommés pour augmenter les DGT infligés par cette invocation d'esprit printanier de 5 % pour chaque cumul consommé.
· Cet effet peut être cumulé 50 fois maximum et dure 60 s.

constellations.name: Divinisation
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Délivrance de la demoiselle divine</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Abandon mystique
constellations.desc: Lorsqu'un personnage déclenche les effets d'un <k>pennage glacé</k> avec les DGT d'une attaque normale ou chargée, aucun cumul n'est consommé.
